english.notes:
(i) This offence was repealed by Schedule 10 to the Employment Rights Act 2025 and no longer applies after 6th April 2026.
(ii) Section 11B of the Employment Agencies Act 1973 provides that the court in which a person is convicted of an offence under this Act may order him to pay to the Secretary of State a sum which appears to the court not to exceed the costs of the investigation which resulted in the conviction.
